test_add_constant: test the add_constant function with various tensor sizes and constant values on CUDA
build_add_constant_cuda_kernel: build a CUDA kernel that adds a constant integer to every element of an int32 tensor
test_add_constant_edge_cases: test add_constant with edge-case sizes like 1, 127, 128, 1024, 1025 and negative constants
register_cuda_ci_suite: register a CUDA CI test with estimated runtime and suite name for stage-b and nightly runs
run_add_constant_pytest: run pytest on test_add_constant.py to verify add_constant correctness against src + constant
